sentences.ar: وصلوا مدينة كلكتا بعد مشوار تعبان.
sentences.en: They reached the city of Calcutta after a tiring trip.

sentences.ar: بس أول ما نزلوا، جت الشرطة وأمسكت باسبارتو.
sentences.en: But as soon as they got off, the police came and arrested Passepartout.

sentences.ar: كان قبل هيك عمل مشكلة صغيرة بمعبد بالغلط.
sentences.en: He had earlier caused a small problem at a temple by mistake.

sentences.ar: راحوا كلهم عالمحكمة، وفوغ دفع مصاري ليطلعوهم.
sentences.en: They all went to court, and Fogg paid money to get them released.

sentences.ar: فيكس كان فرحان، لأنه هالتأخير بيساعده.
sentences.en: Fix was happy, because this delay helped him.

sentences.ar: بس فوغ ما ضيّع وقت، وركبوا المركب فورًا.
sentences.en: But Fogg didn't waste time, and they boarded the ship at once.
This time they were headed to Hong Kong.

sentences.ar: عودا سألت فوغ ليش عم يساعدها هالقد.
sentences.en: Aouda asked Fogg why he was helping her so much.

sentences.ar: قال لها بهدوء: هاد الإشي الصح، وبس.
sentences.en: He told her calmly: it's the right thing, that's all.
The ship set sail, and the journey continued.
